newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain privatisations to bring in 460 bln pta in 97.
newsitem.headline: Spain privatisations to bring in 460 bln pta in 97.

text.p: Spain's state holding company SEPI will receive privatisation income of 460 billion pesetas next year, Industry Ministry Josep Pique said on Wednesday.
"SEPI will see income of 460 billion pesetas from privatisations in 1997" Pique told a senate industry committee.
The most significant SEPI share offerings next year will be 10 percent of oil group Repsol, to be sold in the first half of 1997, and a share offering in electricity firm Endesa in the second half.
Pique said that the 15 percent of Endesa initially planned to be sold could be raised to 20 or 25 percent.
He also reiterated that electricity tariffs will fall an average of three percent in peseta terms from January 1.
